Tests batch bytes extraction API (extract_batch)

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Xberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var result = await XbergConverter.ExtractBatchAsync(new List<ExtractInput>() { JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ExtractInput>("{\"bytes\":\"pdf/fake_memo.pdf\",\"filename\":\"fake_memo.pdf\",\"kind\":\"bytes\"}", ConfigOptions)! }, new ExtractionConfig());
Console.WriteLine(result.Results[0].MimeType);
Console.WriteLine(result.Results[0].Content);
```
